findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms force you to wait three months after invoicing to get paid, creating a severe cash flow strain for a freelancer.
findings.suggested_change: Propose changing the payment terms to Net 15 or Net 30.

findings.quoted_text: Either party may terminate for convenience upon 19 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date.
findings.explanation: Even though it is written neutrally as either party, termination for convenience on short notice allows the client to cancel abruptly, leaving you with sudden lost income.
findings.suggested_change: Remove termination for convenience or add a requirement for a kill fee.

findings.quoted_text: 2.10 Requirements analysis and discovery. 2.11 Implementation of agreed software components. 2.12 Configuration and integration with third-party systems. 2.13 Quality assurance and defect correction. 2.14 Deployment support and technical documentation.
findings.explanation: Listing these broad service categories in the background without precise boundaries invites the client to demand extensive integrations under the fixed fee.
findings.suggested_change: Reference a detailed Statement of Work that explicitly defines project boundaries and exclusions.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to get started and have a few small adjustments to propose before we sign. - Regarding the payment terms, waiting three months to be paid creates significant cash flow strain, so I propose changing the terms to Net 30. - Regarding the termination terms, short notice allows for abrupt cancellation and sudden lost income, so I propose removing termination for convenience or adding a requirement for a kill fee. - Regarding the service scope outlined in the relevant clause, broad categories without precise boundaries can create misunderstandings about project limits, so I propose referencing a detailed Statement of Work that explicitly defines project boundaries and exclusions. Please let me know if these updates sound acceptable. Best regards.
